family_wise_maxT_p_value.rule: p = (1 + #{max-Z_null >= max Z_obs}) / (1 + B), the plus-one finite-permutation convention; B = 999 permutations registered before exposure
family_wise_maxT_p_value.scope: ONE family-wise number for the maximum statistic over all k claims — it is not a per-claim p-value and says nothing about the other survivors
